pataka.name: Pataka
pataka.description: All four fingers extended and held together, thumb bent in to touch the base of the index finger.

tripataka.name: Tripataka
tripataka.description: Pataka with the ring finger bent. The three remaining raised fingers give the hasta its name.

ardhachandra.name: Ardhachandra
ardhachandra.description: All four fingers extended and spread, thumb stretched out fully so the hand forms a crescent.

mushti.name: Mushti
mushti.description: All four fingers curled into the palm, thumb pressed over them.

shikhara.name: Shikhara
shikhara.description: All four fingers curled into the palm, thumb raised straight up.

kapittha.name: Kapittha
kapittha.description: Fingers curled, thumb pressing over the tip of the bent index finger.
